verdict.rationale: The DGX B200 can be operated and automated without a GUI. The docs describe command-line health checks, node-wide GPU administration software, `nvidia-smi` reporting, Docker Engine with the NVIDIA Container Toolkit for scripted workloads, and BMC remote management via Redfish, IPMI and SNMP. Nothing documents CI or pipeline integration, so headless automation is only implied from these building blocks. Missing for 10: documented CI/pipeline integration, an automation API reference (OpenAPI probe returned 404), and independent hands-on reports of headless/CI automation.
